items_all.title: Your Experts Have Partners. There's HOPE for Keeping Them Together
items_all.reader_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have enabled state-of-the-art LLMs to be scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but they come with a fundamental and costly caveat: every expert MLP must occupy memory at inference time, even though the vast majority are idle for any given token. For example, Qwen3.5-122B has 256 experts in each of its 48 MoE layers, and 95% of its ~250 GB parameter memory footprint is taken up entirely by these expert MLPs alone. However, for any given token, only 8 experts in each layer are actually used.
items_all.summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）模型使最先進的 LLMs 能夠擴展到數千億個參數，但它們伴隨著一個根本且代價高昂的限制：每個專家 MLP 必須在推論時佔用記憶體，儘管絕大多數專家對於任何特定的 Token 來說都是閒置的。例如，Qwen3.5-122B 在其 48 個 MoE 層中的每一層都有 256 個專家，其約 250 GB 的參數記憶體佔用空間中有 95% 完全被這些專家 MLP 本身佔用。然而，對於任何特定的 Token 來說，每層實際上只使用了 8 個專家。

items_all.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
items_all.summary: Anthropic is releasing Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, its most powerful models to date, in two versions: one freely available and one reserved for verified organizations. The models solve open physics problems, show stronger cybersecurity capabilities, design functioning operating systems, and write more than 90 percent of the changes merged into Anthropic's core code, according to the company. Anthropic says it has deliberately curbed any capabilities that would let the AI accelerate its own development. The article Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出迄今為止最強大的模型 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2，共分為兩個版本：一個可自由使用，另一個則保留給已驗證的組織。該公司表示，這些模型解決了開放的物理學問題、展現了更強大的網路安全能力、設計出能運作的作業系統，並編寫了超過百分之九十合併至 Anthropic's 核心程式碼的變更。Anthropic 表示，其已刻意抑制了任何會讓該 AI 加速自身發展的能力。

items_all.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
items_all.summary: Meta is introducing Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model, optimized for repetitive agent tasks such as tool calls, routing, and data extraction. items_all.title: Tencent's AI chief says AI bioweapons are coming, but closing off models isn't the answer
items_all.summary: Tencent chief AI scientist Vinces Yao Shunyu warns that AI will soon be able to develop bioweapons and argues for a middle ground between open and closed models. While safety filters on open-source systems can be easily stripped through abliteration, closed models like Anthropic's Claude often block too aggressively. For its upcoming open-weight model Hy4, Tencent is filtering dangerous hacking knowledge directly from the training data. The article Tencent's AI chief says AI bioweapons are coming, but closing off models isn't the answer appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 騰訊 首席 AI 科學家 Vinces Yao Shunyu 警告稱，AI 將很快能夠開發出生物武器，並主張在開源和閉源模型之間尋找折衷方案。雖然開源系統上的安全過濾器可以透過去洗白（abliteration）輕鬆剝離，但像 Anthropic's Claude 這樣的閉源模型往往阻擋得過於激進。對於即將推出的開源權重模型 Hy4，騰訊 正直接從訓練資料中過濾掉危險的駭客知識。

items_all.title: 搶攻企業AI規模化的需求，Google新推兩款TPU新系統，TPU首度支援機密運算
items_all.summary: 為了搶攻企業AI規模化的需求，Google再次加快TPU產品的發布速度，首度一年推出四款TPU產品。 Google今天發表了兩款第八代TPU新系統，分別是支援機密運算的TPU 8tx，以及因應百萬級Token上下文需求的TPU 8i Max。 Google今年4月才在Next大會發表兩款針對AI生命週期不同用途設計的第八代TPU晶片 ，瞄準大規模模型訓練最佳化的TPU 8t，以及針對低延遲推論最佳化的TPU 8i。不到半年，Google在這兩款TPU晶片的基礎上，推出了兩款新的TPU系統。

items_all.title: Dropbox砸3.5億美元收購Tigris，進軍AI儲存基礎設施市場

items_all.title: 黃仁勳承認婚外情，Nvidia董事會調查涉諜疑雲
items_all.summary: 在外界傳出Nvidia創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳涉及婚外情，並可能成為外國情報活動鎖定目標後，黃仁勳週日（11/8）發表公開宣告，承認對妻子不忠，並向家人、員工及股東道歉。Nvidia董事會同日宣佈啟動獨立調查，以釐清相關事件是否危及美國國家安全或公司機密。

items_all.title: OpenAI Images 2.6支援GIF動畫生成，API新增SVG圖檔輸出與編輯控制
items_all.summary: OpenAI推出新版影像生成技術Images 2.6，支援製作GIF動畫，並擴充影像生成API的SVG輸出與編輯控制功能，新版已在ChatGPT、Codex及API推出，官方表示，影像生成速度較以往提高50%。 Images 2.6可依據文字指令製作迴圈播放的GIF動畫，也能將手繪草圖轉成動態角色，應用包括品牌吉祥物、產品展示及社群貼圖。ChatGPT使用者可調整動畫播放速度並分享GIF，目前GIF生成功能正逐步開放，開發者也能透過API指定動畫影格數量及每個影格的顯示時間，單段GIF支援2至16個影格。

items_all.title: 有民眾透過AI學會架設自動化網路攻擊系統，高雄警方破案示警網路犯罪門檻降低
items_all.summary: 高雄市政府警察局刑事警察大隊11月6日公佈一起駭客竊取個資案件，38歲林姓男子涉嫌透過AI學會程式撰寫及網路架設技術，建立自動化網路攻擊系統，非法侵入網站後臺，竊取超過23萬筆會員及客戶個人資料，再於網路上販售牟利。警方已於10月將嫌犯查緝到案，全案依妨害電腦使用罪嫌移送高雄地方檢察署偵辦。

items_all.title: 蘋果給 AI 收費劃了新道：不包月，按用量買斷
items_all.summary: 據9to5Mac 11月9日披露，蘋果開始爲部分AI功能發售付費擴容方案“智能使用包”，首個落地Logic Pro。該方案定價49.99美元（約334元人民幣），一次買斷管一年，不走月度訂閱。用戶買的是12個月有效期用量包，當月基礎額度用盡後才啓動消耗，未用完可逐月結轉，可在Logic Pro菜單欄購買。

source_material.summary: 據9to5Mac 11月9日披露，蘋果開始爲部分AI功能發售付費擴容方案“智能使用包”，首個落地Logic Pro。該方案定價49.99美元（約334元人民幣），一次買斷管一年，不走月度訂閱。用戶買的是12個月有效期用量包，當月基礎額度用盡後才啓動消耗，未用完可逐月結轉，可在Logic Pro菜單欄購買。

items_all.title: Anthropic 發佈 Claude Fable5.2與 Mythos5.2:1000個子智能體8天寫出可啓動操作系統
items_all.summary: 11月9日，Anthropic發佈Claude Fable5.2與Mythos5.2，共用底層模型，主攻編程、推理與視覺。Fable面向廣泛用戶，Mythos限審覈機構。Fable5.2協調1000多個子智能體連續8天，從空文件夾寫出可在筆記本啓動的操作系統原型，含內核、磁盤、鍵盤驅動、文件存儲、窗口與登錄界面；還以30小時將費馬大定理證明轉爲可逐步校驗的Lean形式化證明。

items_all.title: OpenAI 構建中央控制室：實時追蹤模型工作負載，確保異常幹預後 35 秒內秒級叫停
items_all.summary: 近日OpenAI宣佈構建全新中央研究工作負載管控系統Control Room，以應對前沿AI模型規模與推理能力飆升帶來的高風險安全監控和緊急叫停需求。系統核心是實時追蹤研究基礎設施中的模型工作負載，發現潛在安全或安保隱患時，能以極高速度切斷相關工作負載，強化運行時安全管控與應急響應。

items_all.title: Medium 推出全新 AI 寫作輔助應用 TK，將大模型深度融入創作流程
items_all.summary: Medium於2026年11月9日推出AI寫作輔助應用TK，將大模型融入長篇散文創作初期。用戶在編輯器中輸入“@TK”及提示詞，即可調用AI獲取資料解答、導入素材片段，並獲得符合特定出版物風格指南的標題建議與編輯反饋。TK之名取自出版界“待補充”佔位符，寓意幫助作者填補創作空白。

source_material.summary: 在AI技術爆發背景下，微軟CEO納德拉做客裏德·霍夫曼播客《Possible》，分享對未來企業組織形態與人機協作的宏大設想，引發科技界熱議。他提出顛覆性假設：未來企業可能擁有20萬名員工，同時配備200萬甚至2000萬個智能體，讓人類與海量AI智能體協同共事，重塑組織邊界與工作方式。

items_all.summary: 11月9日，英偉達在韓國首爾舉辦NVIDIA AI Day，公佈與韓國科學信息通信技術部及三星、LG電子、現代汽車集團等本土頂尖企業和研究機構的多項深度合作。合作聚焦深化主權AI生態建設，全面賦能本地大模型與基礎設施，並在國家級層面推進與MSIT等協作，引發科技界廣泛關注。

items_all.title: Meta 迎來重磅升級：基於 Muse Wonder 訓練的專用模型全面登陸 Muse 與 Meta AI
items_all.summary: 11月6日，Meta發佈公告，將基於前沿大模型Muse Wonder訓練的系列專用模型推向Muse與Meta AI用戶，賦能日常對話與複雜任務處理。其個人超級智能指數大幅提升，並繼承Muse Wonder在工作與生活複雜任務中的業界領先表現。這顯示AI競爭正加速向深度交互與任務執行的長效能力挺進。

items_all.title: 古爾曼爆料：Siri 最快明年變身自主代理，正面硬剛 OpenAI 與 Meta
items_all.summary: AI競爭正從基礎對話轉向能獨立執行任務的代理（Agent）時代。彭博社記者馬克·古爾曼爆料，蘋果最早明年推出自主代理式Siri，使其從被動響應命令升級爲可主動管理任務、代表用戶辦事的智能助手，並對標ChatGPT Dots、Meta Muse與Grok等行業最高標準。這顯示大廠正加速搶佔代理式AI入口。

items_all.title: 幾秒鐘“復刻”巨星?Suno再因侵權被告上法庭
items_all.summary: AI音樂平臺Suno再遭版權侵權訴訟。貓王版權實體與埃米納姆歌曲出版公司Eight Mile Style近日起訴Suno，指控其未經授權使用知名藝人形象及作品生成AI歌曲，嚴重侵犯版權。訴訟核心是Suno生成內容在旋律、風格和歌詞上高度模仿傳奇音樂人。原告律師稱，此類工具未經數年藝術積累。

items_all.title: DeepSeek 開源智能體應用 Harness 日活突破 154 萬：上線不到三月，單日大模型消耗飆升至 92T 詞元
items_all.summary: 彭博社報道，DeepSeek開源智能體應用框架Harness上線不到三個月表現搶眼，官方API日活用戶已達154萬，較9月30日桌面版推出後7日均值27.1萬顯著增長。用戶激增也推高算力消耗，長時智能體任務成“吞金獸”，其算力資源消耗引發行業高度關注。

items_all.title: 騰訊元器平臺今日正式停止服務:數據導出截至2027年1月
items_all.summary: 騰訊元器今日正式停服，應用訪問、數據讀寫、API調用及控制檯等公衆服務關閉；發佈至公衆號、服務號、微信客服等渠道的智能體同步停止響應。此前，平臺已於上月29日停止創建新智能體及API Key分發。用戶現可通過數據導出控制檯申請導出，受理截至2027年1月9日；除法定須留存日誌外，官方將在到期後處理。

items_all.title: 蘋果Siri AI全面控制應用延期至2027年春季上線
items_all.summary: 蘋果調整AI推進節奏：iOS 27.3測試版已讓Siri處理部分基礎第一方應用任務，但更大規模的原生應用深度控制及關鍵第三方應用支持，預計推遲至2027年春季，或隨iOS 27.5/27.6以預覽推出。蘋果正借App Intents框架加速追趕，但任務複雜度與自主性仍待提升，整體上線晚於預期。

items_all.title: llm-anthropic 0.31
items_all.summary: Release: llm-anthropic 0.31 Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 today. I've added them to llm-anthropic , so you can now run prompts through Fable 5.2 like this: I ran pelicans at all five reasoning levels - low , medium , high , xhigh , and max . You can see them all here - here's the best result I got, from xhigh : max failed to return an image at all, running out of tokens after spending 128,000 thinking about them . That's the same bug that I saw with Opus 5.5 - but it's new for the Fable series, both Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 returned max effort pelicans just fine. items_all.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm-anthropic 0.31 Anthropic 今日發布了 Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2。我已將它們加入 llm-anthropic 中，因此你現在可以透過 Fable 5.2 執行提示詞，就像這樣：我在所有五個推理級別（low、medium、high、xhigh 和 max）下都執行了鵜鶘。你可以在這裡看到所有這些結果 — 這是從 xhigh 獲得的最佳結果：max 完全無法返回圖像，在花費 128,000 個 token 思考它們之後耗盡了 token。這是我在 Opus 5.5 上看到的相同錯誤 — 但對於 Fable 系列來說這是新問題，Fable 5 和 Fable 5.1 都正常返回了最大努力的鵜鶘。標籤：llm, anthropic, claude, generative-ai, pelican-riding-a-bicycle, ai, llms, claude-mythos-fable

items_all.title: Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
items_all.summary: Our house has a box room, full of boxes that we still haven't unpacked from our last move. A couple of weeks ago something in that room started intermittently beeping . The beeps were far enough apart that standing in the room and trying to determine the source of the noise was frustrating, and I really didn't want to dig through every one of those boxes. So I had Claude Code build Beep Locator , a software system for triangulating the source of a mysterious beep using multiple devices scattered around the room. Here's what Beep Locator looks like after it has been running for a while: You run Python web server to show the primary UI, and then use the QR code or URL to connect as many devices as you can spare to act as listeners - I was using two iPads, a phone, a MacBook Pro and a Surface Ultra. The devices then play noises to each other to help estimate their locations. This didn't work particularly well, so I added a "Rough mode" where you can drag their icons around in the space to provide rough locations which are then adjusted based on those sounds. Once that's set up, the devices all listen for the beep! I added a clapping mode too so I could test it by clapping my hands in different locations around the room - displayed as diamonds on the map. This helped me gain confidence that it was capable of locating a sound. Beeps show up on the map as an X, plus a line in the "Sounds located" log. You can replay these sounds (from each device in turn) to confirm they are the mysterious beep you are looking for, then click "This is the mystery beep" to mark them as such. Once
items_all.summary_zh: 我們家有一個儲藏小房間，裡面塞滿了自上次搬家以來一直還沒拆箱的紙箱。幾個星期前，那個房間裡的東西開始斷斷續續地發出嗶嗶聲。嗶嗶聲的間隔時間很長，以至於站在房間裡試圖確定噪音來源令人感到沮喪，而且我真的不想翻遍每一個箱子。所以我讓Claude Code建立了 Beep Locator，這是一個使用散佈在房間各處的多個裝置來三角定位神秘嗶嗶聲來源的軟體系統。以下是 Beep Locator 執行了一陣子後的樣貌：您執行 Python 網路伺服器來顯示主要的使用者介面，然後使用 QR code 或 URL 連線盡可能多出閒置的裝置來充當監聽器 - 我當時使用了兩臺 iPad、一支手機、一臺 MacBook Pro 和一臺 Surface Ultra。接著，這些裝置會互相播放聲音來幫助估算它們的位置。這個方法效果不太好，所以我加入了「粗略模式」，讓您可以在空間中拖曳它們的圖示來提供大致的位置，然後再根據這些聲音進行調整。一旦設定好後，所有裝置都會聆聽嗶嗶聲！我還加入了一個拍手模式，這樣我就可以透過在房間各處的不同位置拍手來測試它 - 在地圖上顯示為菱形。這有助於我建立信心，相信它有能力定位聲音。嗶嗶聲在地圖上顯示為一個 X，外加「已定位聲音」記錄中的一條線。您可以（依序從每個裝置）重新播放這些聲音以確認它們是您正在尋找的神秘嗶嗶聲，然後點選「這是神秘嗶嗶聲」將它們標記為此類。一旦

items_all.title: The Web Is More Than Enough, by Paul Ford
items_all.summary: My comment on The Web Is More Than Enough, by Paul Ford — Hacker News. OK, this comment convinced me to give that a shot. Here's a thing I made in Three.js this morning - a Nudibranch themed Faberge Egg: https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/Hidden-Reef-Egg... (77KB) I just asked Claude (Opus 5.5 Medium running in regular Claude Chat) to port that to Vanilla JS, in the same thread where it had built it, and got this: https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/Hidden-Reef-Egg... (98KB) They aren't identical - you can see what Claude said about that in the transcript (I don't fully understand why it differed): https://claude.ai/share/e56d163e-2793-4677-aa11-191d5058b414 But yeah, it turns out Claude Opus 5.5 is perfectly capable of 3D modeling in Vanilla JS + WebGL without Three.js. In eyeballing the code I find the Three.js slightly easier to understand myself, but I rarely look at the code for these 3D projects so that isn't a particularly big deal. Tags: claude , javascript , three-js , hacker-news , generative-ai , ai , llms

items_all.title: Hide your slop PR descriptions behind <details><summary>
items_all.summary: Most of the changes I make to my projects these days come in the form of PRs opened for me by Claude Code or Codex. The PR is my unit of work - I use them to bundle commits together, iterating on them until a feature is complete, document decisions and then merge the finished result. Today's coding agents are great at writing PR descriptions. They're too good at describing the work The problem is that they are too good. An agent-written PR description is accurate and comprehensive. It describes the problem, the detailed solution, and the steps taken to verify it. That's a lot of information to absorb. It's not necessarily slop, but it reads like slop! It's very easy to spot an AI-written PR, and as with other forms of AI writing my instant reaction is best summarized as "I'm not reading all of that". It doesn't matter how accurate or useful the information is, I'm instantly put off by the thought that it will take me longer to read than it took the driving author to write... even when that driving author is me! I want human editorial judgement. I want someone to have thought just long enough about the PR to give me a human-approved introduction that helps me understand, at a high level, what the PR is for and whether it deserves more of my attention. I think I've found a low-effort way to do this that feels right. items_all_raw.title: 蘋果給 AI 收費劃了新道：不包月，按用量買斷
items_all_raw.summary: 據9to5Mac 11月9日披露，蘋果開始爲部分AI功能發售付費擴容方案“智能使用包”，首個落地Logic Pro。該方案定價49.99美元（約334元人民幣），一次買斷管一年，不走月度訂閱。用戶買的是12個月有效期用量包，當月基礎額度用盡後才啓動消耗，未用完可逐月結轉，可在Logic Pro菜單欄購買。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic 發佈 Claude Fable5.2與 Mythos5.2:1000個子智能體8天寫出可啓動操作系統
items_all_raw.summary: 11月9日，Anthropic發佈Claude Fable5.2與Mythos5.2，共用底層模型，主攻編程、推理與視覺。Fable面向廣泛用戶，Mythos限審覈機構。Fable5.2協調1000多個子智能體連續8天，從空文件夾寫出可在筆記本啓動的操作系統原型，含內核、磁盤、鍵盤驅動、文件存儲、窗口與登錄界面；還以30小時將費馬大定理證明轉爲可逐步校驗的Lean形式化證明。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI 構建中央控制室：實時追蹤模型工作負載，確保異常幹預後 35 秒內秒級叫停
items_all_raw.summary: 近日OpenAI宣佈構建全新中央研究工作負載管控系統Control Room，以應對前沿AI模型規模與推理能力飆升帶來的高風險安全監控和緊急叫停需求。系統核心是實時追蹤研究基礎設施中的模型工作負載，發現潛在安全或安保隱患時，能以極高速度切斷相關工作負載，強化運行時安全管控與應急響應。

items_all_raw.title: Medium 推出全新 AI 寫作輔助應用 TK，將大模型深度融入創作流程
items_all_raw.summary: Medium於2026年11月9日推出AI寫作輔助應用TK，將大模型融入長篇散文創作初期。用戶在編輯器中輸入“@TK”及提示詞，即可調用AI獲取資料解答、導入素材片段，並獲得符合特定出版物風格指南的標題建議與編輯反饋。TK之名取自出版界“待補充”佔位符，寓意幫助作者填補創作空白。

items_all_raw.title: llm-anthropic 0.31
items_all_raw.summary: Release: llm-anthropic 0.31 Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 today. I've added them to llm-anthropic , so you can now run prompts through Fable 5.2 like this: I ran pelicans at all five reasoning levels - low , medium , high , xhigh , and max . You can see them all here - here's the best result I got, from xhigh : max failed to return an image at all, running out of tokens after spending 128,000 thinking about them . That's the same bug that I saw with Opus 5.5 - but it's new for the Fable series, both Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 returned max effort pelicans just fine. Tags: llm , anthropic , claude , generative-ai , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , ai , llms , claude-mythos-fable
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm-anthropic 0.31 Anthropic 今日發布了 Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2。我已將它們加入 llm-anthropic 中，因此你現在可以透過 Fable 5.2 執行提示詞，就像這樣：我在所有五個推理級別（low、medium、high、xhigh 和 max）下都執行了鵜鶘。你可以在這裡看到所有這些結果 — 這是從 xhigh 獲得的最佳結果：max 完全無法返回圖像，在花費 128,000 個 token 思考它們之後耗盡了 token。這是我在 Opus 5.5 上看到的相同錯誤 — 但對於 Fable 系列來說這是新問題，Fable 5 和 Fable 5.1 都正常返回了最大努力的鵜鶘。標籤：llm, anthropic, claude, generative-ai, pelican-riding-a-bicycle, ai, llms, claude-mythos-fable

items_all_raw.title: Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
items_all_raw.summary: Our house has a box room, full of boxes that we still haven't unpacked from our last move. A couple of weeks ago something in that room started intermittently beeping . The beeps were far enough apart that standing in the room and trying to determine the source of the noise was frustrating, and I really didn't want to dig through every one of those boxes. So I had Claude Code build Beep Locator , a software system for triangulating the source of a mysterious beep using multiple devices scattered around the room. Here's what Beep Locator looks like after it has been running for a while: You run Python web server to show the primary UI, and then use the QR code or URL to connect as many devices as you can spare to act as listeners - I was using two iPads, a phone, a MacBook Pro and a Surface Ultra. The devices then play noises to each other to help estimate their locations. This didn't work particularly well, so I added a "Rough mode" where you can drag their icons around in the space to provide rough locations which are then adjusted based on those sounds. Once that's set up, the devices all listen for the beep! I added a clapping mode too so I could test it by clapping my hands in different locations around the room - displayed as diamonds on the map. This helped me gain confidence that it was capable of locating a sound. Beeps show up on the map as an X, plus a line in the "Sounds located" log. You can replay these sounds (from each device in turn) to confirm they are the mysterious beep you are looking for, then click "This is the mystery beep" to mark them as such. Once
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 我們家有一個儲藏小房間，裡面塞滿了自上次搬家以來一直還沒拆箱的紙箱。幾個星期前，那個房間裡的東西開始斷斷續續地發出嗶嗶聲。嗶嗶聲的間隔時間很長，以至於站在房間裡試圖確定噪音來源令人感到沮喪，而且我真的不想翻遍每一個箱子。所以我讓Claude Code建立了 Beep Locator，這是一個使用散佈在房間各處的多個裝置來三角定位神秘嗶嗶聲來源的軟體系統。以下是 Beep Locator 執行了一陣子後的樣貌：您執行 Python 網路伺服器來顯示主要的使用者介面，然後使用 QR code 或 URL 連線盡可能多出閒置的裝置來充當監聽器 - 我當時使用了兩臺 iPad、一支手機、一臺 MacBook Pro 和一臺 Surface Ultra。接著，這些裝置會互相播放聲音來幫助估算它們的位置。這個方法效果不太好，所以我加入了「粗略模式」，讓您可以在空間中拖曳它們的圖示來提供大致的位置，然後再根據這些聲音進行調整。一旦設定好後，所有裝置都會聆聽嗶嗶聲！我還加入了一個拍手模式，這樣我就可以透過在房間各處的不同位置拍手來測試它 - 在地圖上顯示為菱形。這有助於我建立信心，相信它有能力定位聲音。嗶嗶聲在地圖上顯示為一個 X，外加「已定位聲音」記錄中的一條線。您可以（依序從每個裝置）重新播放這些聲音以確認它們是您正在尋找的神秘嗶嗶聲，然後點選「這是神秘嗶嗶聲」將它們標記為此類。一旦

items_all_raw.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic is releasing Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, its most powerful models to date, in two versions: one freely available and one reserved for verified organizations. The models solve open physics problems, show stronger cybersecurity capabilities, design functioning operating systems, and write more than 90 percent of the changes merged into Anthropic's core code, according to the company. Anthropic says it has deliberately curbed any capabilities that would let the AI accelerate its own development. The article Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出迄今為止最強大的模型 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2，共分為兩個版本：一個可自由使用，另一個則保留給已驗證的組織。該公司表示，這些模型解決了開放的物理學問題、展現了更強大的網路安全能力、設計出能運作的作業系統，並編寫了超過百分之九十合併至 Anthropic's 核心程式碼的變更。Anthropic 表示，其已刻意抑制了任何會讓該 AI 加速自身發展的能力。

items_all_raw.title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift
items_all_raw.summary: Bytedance Seed has introduced Seedream 5.5, an image model built for professional production workflows. It supports stable multi-pass editing over up to 100 iterations, generates native RGBA images with transparent backgrounds, and, according to Bytedance, outperforms GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst in realism. A Pro version is planned. The article Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 字節跳動 Seed 推出了 Seedream 5.5，這是一款專為專業生產工作流程打造的圖像模型。它支援在最多 100 次迭代中進行穩定的多輪編輯，可生成帶透明背景的原生 RGBA 圖像，並且據字節跳動表示，其真實感超越了 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst。官方並計劃推出專業版（Pro）。

items_all_raw.title: Tencent's AI chief says AI bioweapons are coming, but closing off models isn't the answer
items_all_raw.summary: Tencent chief AI scientist Vinces Yao Shunyu warns that AI will soon be able to develop bioweapons and argues for a middle ground between open and closed models. While safety filters on open-source systems can be easily stripped through abliteration, closed models like Anthropic's Claude often block too aggressively. For its upcoming open-weight model Hy4, Tencent is filtering dangerous hacking knowledge directly from the training data. The article Tencent's AI chief says AI bioweapons are coming, but closing off models isn't the answer appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 騰訊 首席 AI 科學家 Vinces Yao Shunyu 警告稱，AI 將很快能夠開發出生物武器，並主張在開源和閉源模型之間尋找折衷方案。雖然開源系統上的安全過濾器可以透過去洗白（abliteration）輕鬆剝離，但像 Anthropic's Claude 這樣的閉源模型往往阻擋得過於激進。對於即將推出的開源權重模型 Hy4，騰訊 正直接從訓練資料中過濾掉危險的駭客知識。

items_all_raw.title: Google ships four TPU variants in one year as it ramps up competition with Nvidia
items_all_raw.summary: Google is expanding its TPU 8 family with two specialized variants: the TPU 8tx keeps sensitive data encrypted even during processing, while the TPU 8i Max doubles compute power and memory by placing two chips on a single package. With nearly 100 external customers now on board, Google is increasingly positioning its in-house chips as an alternative to Nvidia's GPUs. The article Google ships four TPU variants in one year as it ramps up competition with Nvidia appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 正在透過兩種專門的變體來擴充其 TPU 8 系列：TPU 8tx 能夠在處理過程中將敏感資料保持加密狀態，而 TPU 8i Max 則透過在單一封裝上放置兩個晶片，將運算能力與記憶體加倍。隨著目前擁有近 100 家外部客戶，Google 越來越將其自家晶片定位為輝達（Nvidia）GPU 的替代方案。

items_all_raw.title: Your Experts Have Partners. There's HOPE for Keeping Them Together
items_all_raw.reader_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have enabled state-of-the-art LLMs to be scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but they come with a fundamental and costly caveat: every expert MLP must occupy memory at inference time, even though the vast majority are idle for any given token. For example, Qwen3.5-122B has 256 experts in each of its 48 MoE layers, and 95% of its ~250 GB parameter memory footprint is taken up entirely by these expert MLPs alone. However, for any given token, only 8 experts in each layer are actually used.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）模型使最先進的 LLMs 能夠擴展到數千億個參數，但它們伴隨著一個根本且代價高昂的限制：每個專家 MLP 必須在推論時佔用記憶體，儘管絕大多數專家對於任何特定的 Token 來說都是閒置的。例如，Qwen3.5-122B 在其 48 個 MoE 層中的每一層都有 256 個專家，其約 250 GB 的參數記憶體佔用空間中有 95% 完全被這些專家 MLP 本身佔用。然而，對於任何特定的 Token 來說，每層實際上只使用了 8 個專家。

items_all_raw.summary: 資安業者Acronis威脅研究單位（TRU）近日揭露，臺灣緊急服務系統遭到名為BossAI的AI攻擊架構鎖定，而且攻擊目標不只是臺灣緊急服務系統，還涵蓋全球11個國家的數百個組織。研究人員進一步發現，這套架構由一名據信位於臺灣花蓮市的攻擊者操作，整合12個AI代理，透過不同代理分工、模型上下文協定（MCP）串接滲透測試工具，並使用移除安全限制的本機AI模型執行攻擊。

items_all_raw.title: AI自動化攻擊系統BossAI鎖定臺灣緊急應變服務
items_all_raw.summary: 11月4日資安公司Acronis揭露AI自動化攻擊系統BossAI，位於臺灣花蓮市的攻擊者打造由12個AI代理組成的系統，在短短12天內鎖定11個國家的數百個組織，涵蓋政府緊急應變服務、金融機構、大學、軍事系統及電子商務平臺等領域，其中臺灣是遭到攻擊最密集的地區，尤以緊急應變服務為主要的目標。

items_all_raw.title: 字節 Seedream 5.5 發佈：支持 100 輪連續編輯與原生透明輸出，全面刷新 AI 圖像創作天花板
items_all_raw.summary: 11月9日，字節Seed團隊發佈新一代圖像創作模型Seedream5.5。該模型延續上代優勢，針對專業視覺生產痛點升級，核心亮點包括非編輯區域像素級保持、最高100輪連續創作、原生RGBA透明素材生成，並顯著提升質感與文字渲染能力，可爲影視、電商、廣告、設計等專業團隊提供更高生成可靠性。

items_all_raw.title: 搶攻企業AI規模化的需求，Google新推兩款TPU新系統，TPU首度支援機密運算
items_all_raw.summary: 為了搶攻企業AI規模化的需求，Google再次加快TPU產品的發布速度，首度一年推出四款TPU產品。 Google今天發表了兩款第八代TPU新系統，分別是支援機密運算的TPU 8tx，以及因應百萬級Token上下文需求的TPU 8i Max。 Google今年4月才在Next大會發表兩款針對AI生命週期不同用途設計的第八代TPU晶片 ，瞄準大規模模型訓練最佳化的TPU 8t，以及針對低延遲推論最佳化的TPU 8i。不到半年，Google在這兩款TPU晶片的基礎上，推出了兩款新的TPU系統。

source_material.summary: 美國雲端儲存業者Dropbox上周四（11/5）宣布，準備以3.5億美元收購AI物件儲存新創Tigris Data，同時發表DBX Agent Cloud，將業務從傳統檔案儲存擴展至AI基礎設施市場，為企業及開發者提供AI應用程式與代理人所需的資料儲存服務。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI Images 2.6支援GIF動畫生成，API新增SVG圖檔輸出與編輯控制
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI推出新版影像生成技術Images 2.6，支援製作GIF動畫，並擴充影像生成API的SVG輸出與編輯控制功能，新版已在ChatGPT、Codex及API推出，官方表示，影像生成速度較以往提高50%。 Images 2.6可依據文字指令製作迴圈播放的GIF動畫，也能將手繪草圖轉成動態角色，應用包括品牌吉祥物、產品展示及社群貼圖。ChatGPT使用者可調整動畫播放速度並分享GIF，目前GIF生成功能正逐步開放，開發者也能透過API指定動畫影格數量及每個影格的顯示時間，單段GIF支援2至16個影格。

items_all_raw.title: The Web Is More Than Enough, by Paul Ford
items_all_raw.summary: My comment on The Web Is More Than Enough, by Paul Ford — Hacker News. OK, this comment convinced me to give that a shot. Here's a thing I made in Three.js this morning - a Nudibranch themed Faberge Egg: https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/Hidden-Reef-Egg... (77KB) I just asked Claude (Opus 5.5 Medium running in regular Claude Chat) to port that to Vanilla JS, in the same thread where it had built it, and got this: https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/Hidden-Reef-Egg... (98KB) They aren't identical - you can see what Claude said about that in the transcript (I don't fully understand why it differed): https://claude.ai/share/e56d163e-2793-4677-aa11-191d5058b414 But yeah, it turns out Claude Opus 5.5 is perfectly capable of 3D modeling in Vanilla JS + WebGL without Three.js. In eyeballing the code I find the Three.js slightly easier to understand myself, but I rarely look at the code for these 3D projects so that isn't a particularly big deal. items_all_raw.title: Hide your slop PR descriptions behind <details><summary>
items_all_raw.summary: Most of the changes I make to my projects these days come in the form of PRs opened for me by Claude Code or Codex. The PR is my unit of work - I use them to bundle commits together, iterating on them until a feature is complete, document decisions and then merge the finished result. Today's coding agents are great at writing PR descriptions. They're too good at describing the work The problem is that they are too good. An agent-written PR description is accurate and comprehensive. It describes the problem, the detailed solution, and the steps taken to verify it. That's a lot of information to absorb. It's not necessarily slop, but it reads like slop! It's very easy to spot an AI-written PR, and as with other forms of AI writing my instant reaction is best summarized as "I'm not reading all of that". It doesn't matter how accurate or useful the information is, I'm instantly put off by the thought that it will take me longer to read than it took the driving author to write... even when that driving author is me! I want human editorial judgement. I want someone to have thought just long enough about the PR to give me a human-approved introduction that helps me understand, at a high level, what the PR is for and whether it deserves more of my attention. I think I've found a low-effort way to do this that feels right. Hide most of it in a details/summary The HTML <details><summary> elements render as a collapsed heading (the summary) that can be expanded to view the larger piece of text. items_all_raw.title: Meta 迎來重磅升級：基於 Muse Wonder 訓練的專用模型全面登陸 Muse 與 Meta AI
items_all_raw.summary: 11月6日，Meta發佈公告，將基於前沿大模型Muse Wonder訓練的系列專用模型推向Muse與Meta AI用戶，賦能日常對話與複雜任務處理。其個人超級智能指數大幅提升，並繼承Muse Wonder在工作與生活複雜任務中的業界領先表現。這顯示AI競爭正加速向深度交互與任務執行的長效能力挺進。

items_all_raw.title: 古爾曼爆料：Siri 最快明年變身自主代理，正面硬剛 OpenAI 與 Meta
items_all_raw.summary: AI競爭正從基礎對話轉向能獨立執行任務的代理（Agent）時代。彭博社記者馬克·古爾曼爆料，蘋果最早明年推出自主代理式Siri，使其從被動響應命令升級爲可主動管理任務、代表用戶辦事的智能助手，並對標ChatGPT Dots、Meta Muse與Grok等行業最高標準。這顯示大廠正加速搶佔代理式AI入口。

items_all_raw.title: 幾秒鐘“復刻”巨星?Suno再因侵權被告上法庭
items_all_raw.summary: AI音樂平臺Suno再遭版權侵權訴訟。貓王版權實體與埃米納姆歌曲出版公司Eight Mile Style近日起訴Suno，指控其未經授權使用知名藝人形象及作品生成AI歌曲，嚴重侵犯版權。訴訟核心是Suno生成內容在旋律、風格和歌詞上高度模仿傳奇音樂人。原告律師稱，此類工具未經數年藝術積累。

items_all_raw.title: xAI 全面升級 Grok Bot，重點優化 Token 效率與智能表現
items_all_raw.summary: xAI 正對旗下 Grok Bot 啓動新一輪底層架構與功能優化。核心成員 Matt Palmer 與創始人馬斯克在 X 宣佈，重點提升 Token 效率並改進智能交互行爲。此次優化針對開發者和企業基於 Grok Bot 構建大量核心工作流與自動化後暴露的痛點，旨在改善效率與使用體驗，相關升級已全面展開。

items_all_raw.title: Google Messages啓動主頁大改版:集成 Gemini 快捷入口、重構置頂與底部搜索
items_all_raw.summary: 11月7日消息，谷歌正爲Android版Google Messages推進重大主頁重新設計，更新已進入測試並逐步推送部分用戶。此次改版含三大核心組件，旨在優化界面佈局、提升單手操作便捷性。視覺上，置頂聊天頭像被提到所有對話列表最上方，藉助背景圖層展示大尺寸聯繫人頭像；搜索功能位置與交互也有調整。目前該設計仍處測試階段。

items_all_raw.title: 騰訊元器平臺今日正式停止服務:數據導出截至2027年1月
items_all_raw.summary: 騰訊元器今日正式停服，應用訪問、數據讀寫、API調用及控制檯等公衆服務關閉；發佈至公衆號、服務號、微信客服等渠道的智能體同步停止響應。此前，平臺已於上月29日停止創建新智能體及API Key分發。用戶現可通過數據導出控制檯申請導出，受理截至2027年1月9日；除法定須留存日誌外，官方將在到期後處理。

items_all_raw.title: 蘋果新 CEO 上任三把火，特努斯逼着費德里吉"大膽搞 AI"
items_all_raw.summary: 彭博社古爾曼在11月8日《Power On》披露，蘋果新任CEO約翰·特努斯正敦促軟件工程主管克雷格·費德里吉加快AI步伐，採取更大膽策略，把Siri升級爲能自主替用戶幹活的AI智能體。特努斯公開在財報會上表現輕鬆，盛讚新版Siri實現多年設想、對反饋滿意；但私下深知蘋果仍遠落後於對手。

items_all_raw.title: 蘋果Siri AI全面控制應用延期至2027年春季上線
items_all_raw.summary: 蘋果調整AI推進節奏：iOS 27.3測試版已讓Siri處理部分基礎第一方應用任務，但更大規模的原生應用深度控制及關鍵第三方應用支持，預計推遲至2027年春季，或隨iOS 27.5/27.6以預覽推出。蘋果正借App Intents框架加速追趕，但任務複雜度與自主性仍待提升，整體上線晚於預期。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI新一輪融資籌集110億美元，估值達1.25萬億美元
items_all_raw.summary: TechCrunch最新報道稱，OpenAI在新一輪融資中已成功籌集110億美元，估值達到1.25萬億美元。知情人士透露，該筆資金屬於一項尚未最終完成的更大規模融資計劃，預計未來幾周全部落定，最終總額有望達約200億美元。此前9月下旬，市場曾傳出OpenAI擬籌集300億美元，目前實際金額顯示預期有所回調。

items_all_raw.title: 新版 Siri 跳票兩年後，蘋果 AI 主帥動了離職念頭
items_all_raw.summary: 彭博社古爾曼爆料，曾主導Vision Pro、後負責新版Siri AI的蘋果高管邁克·羅克韋爾仍考慮離職，最早明年卸任Siri工程副總裁，甚至徹底退出蘋果。新版Siri跳票兩年才勉強上市，羅克韋爾是關鍵推手，將原計劃深度嵌入AI的版本從延期泥潭拖到臺前。

items_all_raw.title: 傳微軟AI Frontiers部門併回Microsoft AI，主管離職
items_all_raw.summary: 微軟研究（Microsoft Research）近日傳出關閉AI尖端（AI Frontiers）部門，成員併回Microsoft AI事業群，而主管則宣佈離開公司。 AI Frontiers部門主管John Langford在個人X帳號及個人部落格宣佈AI Frontiers的結束，並形容留下計畫失敗（train wreck），痛苦難以表達。
